results.market_title: Will the highest temperature in Milan be 23°C on September 17?
results.reasoning: Multiple forecast sources (AccuWeather, Ventusky) for Milan/Linate around Sept 17, 2026 point to a high temperature near 26-27°C (79-81°F), somewhat above the September climatological average of ~24-25°C for the region. Malpensa airport, being further from the city and at slightly higher elevation, often runs a degree or two cooler than central Milan/Linate readings, but even accounting for that the most likely bracket appears to be 24-26°C rather than exactly 23°C. Given several days of lead time, forecast uncertainty remains, but current data leans against the 23°C bracket being the outcome.

results.market_title: Will the Sweden Democrats (SD) win the third most seats in the 2026 Swedish parliamentary election?
results.reasoning: Multiple independent polling aggregators (PolitPro, Ipsos, Polara) consistently show Sverigedemokraterna (SD) polling around 19-20%, ahead of Moderaterna at roughly 17.5-18%, giving SD a fairly stable ~1.5-2.5 point lead and translating to seat projections of roughly SD 70 seats vs. M 65-69 seats. This gap has persisted across many polls and pollsters over recent months, making SD landing in second place (not third) the clear base case, mirroring the 2022 election outcome where SD also finished second ahead of M. For SD to fall to third, M would need to close and overtake a multi-point, multi-pollster gap in the final weeks — possible but not the current trend, so I estimate the probability of SD finishing third at around 15%, below the market's 33% crowd price.
results.key_findings: ["PolitPro Election Trend (Aug 28, 2026): S 30.7%, SD 19.2%, M 17.9% — SD projected 70 seats vs M 65 seats","Ipsos poll (May 2026): SD 20% vs M 19%, SD projected 73 seats vs M 69 seats","Polara aggregator (late Aug 2026): SD 19.6% vs M 17.5%, consistent SD lead over M","2022 election precedent: SD finished second nationally ahead of M, matching the current polling pattern","In 2022 SD already outpolled M, so a reversal in 2026 would require a notable swing in the final stretch before the Sep 13 2026 for M to overtake SD"]

results.market_title: Will the Fed increase interest rates by 25 bps after the September 2026 meeting?
results.reasoning: The Fed is in an unusual mid-cycle debate between renewed hawkish inflation/energy pressure and a weakening labor market. Live prediction markets (Kalshi, ~$16M volume) as of late August 2026 price a 25bp September hike at roughly 30-31%, implying ~69-70% for 'no change,' and weak July/August jobs data (per Motley Fool, Aug 12) has caused hike odds to 'plunge' from earlier July highs near 50%+. Wall Street desks are split (Goldman calling a hike 'very unlikely,' JPMorgan flagging a hike as newly plausible amid energy shocks), but the most recent, highest-liquidity market signal leans toward a hold rather than a hike.
